stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Done by hand, one by one

stations.title: Kit store
stations.text: Every radio ticked and the rope packed.

captions: Thursday is kit night. Dougie checks the store one thing at a time.
Today he does it all by hand, loses his place, and starts again.
You write for loops that repeat each small job for him.
Now every radio, pitch and letter is done, in order, every time.
Loops with for and range, running totals, and text letter by letter.
